scope: 17 high-confidence same-sense or current-detector cases in held source ordinals 2400–2700; no decision, canonical, manifest, or release edits

rows.sourceExample: The repairs could eat up the whole day.
rows.sourceMeaning: Consume all available time; a natural figurative phrasal verb.
rows.ownerMeaning: Consume a substantial amount of time described as half a day, often with a sense that little time remains for other things.
rows.ownerPattern: \beat(?:s|ing)? up half (?:the|a) day\b|\bate up half (?:the|a) day\b|\beaten up half (?:the|a) day\b
rows.recommendation: Extend eat-up time-amount pattern to whole day; maintain duration boundary.
rows.releaseDecision: provisional; independent review and detector tests required
